name: Peripheral Square with an Attached Edge
definition: The five-word family $\{000,100,110,001,101\}$. Equivalently, peripherally expand the path $B=\{00,10,11\}$ along its isometric edge $S=\{00,10\}$.
properties: The last coordinate is peripheral; its contraction base is the three-vertex path and its duplicated site is an edge. Both children recur, so the family belongs to $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}$.
